metrics.GRAMMAR_EOS_VALIDITY: strict free-running sequence must complete with EOS and valid grammar
metrics.BOUNDARY_LOOPS_AND_OPEN_CHAINS: open boundary chains from decoded candidate faces
metrics.SOURCE_SURFACE_FIDELITY: bidirectional candidate-vs-prepared-source surface p95 and max distance
metrics.SOURCE_MASK_FIDELITY: same-camera source silhouette IoU using retained Fit8 court rasterizer
metrics.FACE_ECONOMY: face reduction relative to the qualified direct surface

metrics.GLOBAL_VISIBILITY_ACCURACY: valid V2 teacher hit slots whose nearest same-ray candidate hit has matching tie-safe visible/invisible state; missing/abstaining candidate hit is incorrect
metrics.LOCAL_PARTIAL_ORDER_ACCURACY: valid V2 unordered base pairs whose two teacher surface points map to distinct same-ray candidate hits with matching strict depth order; candidate depth ties or missing hits are incorrect
metrics.FRAGMENT_IDENTITY_STABILITY: for each anonymous teacher face across authoritative view observations, modal candidate connected-component matches divided by all authoritative observations, including missing observations in the denominator
metrics.SOURCE_ART_SUPPORT_PRESERVATION: fraction of deterministic source-foreground evaluation rays with at least one candidate-surface hit

metric.POSE_DEPENDENT_ORDER_FLIP_ACCURACY: on rays where the authored teacher frontmost anonymous owner changes between rest and a sampled authored pose, candidate is correct only if its rest and posed frontmost owner identities both match the corresponding teacher owners

metrics.OWNER_FRAGMENT_STABILITY_OVER_MOTION: for every visible authored anonymous owner observation over all sampled poses/views, count candidate front hits that preserve that owner and the owner's modal persistent candidate connected-component; score is modal-consistent observations divided by all authoritative owner observations
metrics.GAP_TEAR_RATE: candidate face-frame fraction violating the frozen G3 numerical dynamic envelope: nonfinite metrics, area ratio below 0.05, area ratio above 20, or condition number above 16
metrics.ATTACHMENT_PERSISTENCE_WHERE_AUTHORITATI: ABSTAIN when the authored teacher export does not provide explicit contact/attachment relation authority; abstention cannot be converted to a negative or positive label
metrics.G3_DYNAMIC_QUALIFICATION: all sampled authored-motion frames satisfy the same frozen G3 numerical area/condition bounds; frame-pass fraction is retained for no-regression comparison

aggregation.presentation_macro: unweighted mean of the five preregistered presentation metric subject-macros, with only authoritative valid rows contributing inside each metric
aggregation.motion_gap_tear_macro: unweighted mean of subject face-frame violation rates
